stated: The Conservative Party will overhaul the fit note process, moving responsibility for issuing fit notes from GPs to specialist work and health professionals, and integrating this with the WorkWell service to help people stay in or return to work.

source.quote: Overhaul the fit note process so that people are not being signed off sick as a default. ...We will design a new system which moves the responsibility for issuing fit notes away from our hard-pressed GPs towards specialist work and health professionals...

bearing_set.reason: Shifting fit-note responsibility away from GPs would materially affect GP appointment availability and capacity, earning a real verdict on healthcare access.
The policy is explicitly designed to keep people in work or return them to work via WorkWell integration, directly bearing on employment rates and job security.

Reducing health-related economic inactivity at scale materially affects aggregate labour-force participation and productivity — real O13 indicators — particularly given the UK's post-COVID rise in long-term sickness inactivity (~2.8 million people).

membership_note: Three fundamentals bear: O3 (GP capacity released or burdened), O4 (direct employment/work-quality effect on sick workers), O13 (aggregate labour participation and productivity). No O12 bearing included — fiscal effects of changed inactivity are downstream projections not mechanistically direct enough to clear the bar independently here.
